inspect.reason: The provider is transported through authenticated Cordis agent inspection, not a stable public loopback HTTP API. Static capability is pinned; runtime apply remains fail-closed on version mismatch.

regionalPreview.mainSelector: unique div.wSkVaW_heroWorkspaceRow, then its first split-layout ancestor branch whose parent contains the unique sidebar selector
regionalPreview.sidebarOccluderSelector: unique :scope > div > div.hHd-Xa_root.hHd-Xa_quietBars inside the unique sidebar column
regionalPreview.sidebarFadeSelector: optional unique .qDHVXG_fade inside the unique sidebar column; it is mounted only when the rc.6 workspace-list scroll body exists
regionalPreview.linkedCanvas: the parent of that derived main branch is the capability-pinned common split-layout root. In linked mode exactly one backdrop layer is mounted there; the sidebar/main native backgrounds, opaque sidebar content root, and the native workspace-list bottom fade are made transparent, and the sidebar's split-only right border is suppressed. The layer uses the root's live bounds so image cover/position remains continuous after resize. An optional managed one-pixel divider may be overlaid without splitting that canvas.
regionalPreview.splitBoundary: in independent-region mode the plugin either renders the managed divider or a bounded opaque cross-fade at the same measured sidebar edge. The cross-fade exactly matches each structured colour edge, contains no blur or alpha glow, and accepts no CSS input.
regionalPreview.evidence: Observed in Controller-provisioned DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.6 Chromium preview on 2026-08-18; semantic aside/main selectors returned no matches. The inner hHd-Xa sidebar root had opaque rgb(27,27,28) background, qDHVXG_fade was the native 24px bottom sidebar-fill gradient, and the sidebar had a 1px split border.
regionalPreview.uniqueness: sidebar, workspace anchor, and inner sidebar occluder each resolve exactly one HTMLElement; the optional native sidebar fade resolves zero or one HTMLElement, and more than one is rejected. The derived main branch must have non-zero bounds and be outside sidebar. Otherwise the plugin fails closed and does not acknowledge rendering.
regionalPreview.embeddedBridge: loopback parent only; events contain preview session and generation and never carry controller credentials

balanceApi.contract: GET /dsh-skin/balance (loopback-only) proxies the DeepSeek /user/balance endpoint; the API key resolves from DSH_SKIN_BALANCE_API_KEY, then DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, then %DSH_HOME%/.credentials.yaml and never leaves the Host; responses are cached for 30s and refresh=1 bypasses the cache
balanceApi.clientSurface: a composer chip [data-dsh-skin-balance] that mounts on div.FJxK0a_root (conversation.composer.dock) in conversation views and on div.uV2eYG_trailing on the hero, persists its value in localStorage (dsh-skin-balance:v1), and re-queries on click/Enter/Space. The dock re-renders per turn, so the chip is re-appended on every dock replacement.

persistentBase.contract: webServer.tapIndex injects a <style id="dsh-skin-persistent"> into every served index.html: html body / html body[data-ds-dark-theme] token overrides, the linked backdrop painted directly on the body background when blur is 0 and opacity is 1 (html body{background-image…;background-attachment:fixed}) — the most stable layer, which cannot disappear during route transitions — or an html body::before pseudo canvas for blurred/partial-opacity themes, per-panel transparency for .pI_x6G_sidebarCol/.pI_x6G_frame/.pI_x6G_centerCol and the sidebar-scoped .hHd-Xa_root (also position:relative;z-index:1), the .qDHVXG_fade, and the sidebar divider as a persistent .pI_x6G_sidebarCol::after gradient+glow pseudo-element. The conversation mask is default-on for the main region and off only on the hero. Split mode pins region backgrounds on .pI_x6G_sidebarCol/.pI_x6G_centerCol instead.
persistentBase.evidence: Generated style is idempotent and capped at 64 KiB; first-paint availability is guaranteed by a synchronous theme-file fallback in the index transform. The zero-blur linked case paints on the body background, so a route transition (or a transform/filter on a container) can never detach or hide it.
